Lookup of 55 native single-byte converter descriptors, generated from the authenticated LibreOffice descriptor capture already used by SAL converter tests.

The duplicate 47-entry handwritten single-byte switch is replaced by the existing pinned 55-descriptor capture, making all represented reverse data reachable through the shared factory. JIS X0201 records its actual null text-to-Unicode callback separately from absent encoding data. Native unsigned16 lookup binding is preserved. Other native registry encoding families and native function-pointer ABI remain unported.
omittedResponsibilities: Other encoding families and complete SAL conversion factories remain outside the current Writer filter slice.
The original registry also owns multibyte/contextual converters and factory dispatch. Metadata for represented encodings is owned by tencinfo.ts; other registry branches remain unported.
